summary: ETH ~$2,280, +0.7% in 24h, briefly back near $2,300. A one-block Ethereum reorg on 31 Oct caused THORChain to pay out 10 ETH in error and halt ETH swaps (funds returned); a small knock to sentiment, not to ETH itself. Otherwise following BTC.
catalyst_note: THORChain halted ETH swaps after a 31 Oct one-block reorg
